conf.comment: linux-syslog / cron / syslog-raw. No integration parses cronie's grammar, so this pipeline does the whole job from _raw: RFC3164-style header regex for PRI/timestamp/hostname/program/pid, then the map's literal cronie body regex on the remainder. Header timestamp has no year (RFC3164), so current-year is assumed same as the deployed map. CMDOUT drop/sample recommendation NOT implemented (no concrete rate given) -- see README gap.

functions.description: record parsing approach and the CMDOUT sampling gap
split the RFC3164 syslog header (PRI, timestamp, hostname, program, pid) from the cronie message body
the map's own cronie grammar on the body; trailing ': <errtext>' is a documented extension (see README) since the map names an errno tail but does not give its exact syntax
derive every computed/branched field from the ORIGINAL regex-extracted names before renaming (order rule: compute before rename)
batch rename the remaining clean 1:1 fields
tag event.dataset and drop consumed intermediate fields
